// 复杂到简单片头：上百条连线与节点收束成一条横线，再逐字出标题。作为代码素材播放性能的固定负载。
// 发光用图层上的 GPU glow，背景不变就沿用；连线、节点和逐字入场由 Canvas 每帧画。
import { glow } from 'henji-effects';

const hash = n => { const x = Math.sin(n * 127.1 + 20261.015) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x) };
const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));
const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
const progress = (t, start, duration) => clamp((t - start) / duration, 0, 1);
const smoothstep = (a, b, x) => { const t = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t) };
const cubicInOut = t => t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;
const expoOut = t => t >= 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t);
const rgba = (hex, a) => { const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 7), 16); return `rgba(${n >> 16 & 255}, ${n >> 8 & 255}, ${n & 255}, ${a})` };

function node(i, t, c, w) {
  const nx = 96 + hash(i * 5 + 1) * (w - 192);
  const ny = 540 + (hash(i * 5 + 2) - 0.5) * 640;
  const amp = 36 * (1 - c) * (1 - c);
  return [lerp(nx, w / 2 + (nx - w / 2) * 0.955, c) + Math.sin(i * 2.399 + t * 1.15) * amp, lerp(ny, 540, c) + Math.sin(i * 1.717 - t * 1.63) * amp * 1.45];
}

function strand(ctx, i, j, t, c, w, tint) {
  const trim = progress(t, 0.45 + i * 0.0016, 0.62);
  if (trim <= 0) return;
  const a = node(i, t, c, w), b = node(j, t, c, w), d = hash(i * 9 + 4);
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(tint, 0.1 + 0.34 * d); ctx.lineWidth = 0.6 + d * 1.2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); ctx.lineTo(lerp(a[0], b[0], trim), lerp(a[1], b[1], trim)); ctx.stroke();
}

function dot(ctx, i, t, c, w, tint) {
  const grow = progress(t, 0.12 + i * 0.0022, 0.55);
  if (grow <= 0) return;
  const a = node(i, t, c, w), d = hash(i * 5 + 3);
  const s = (1.6 + d * d * 5.2) * (1 - 0.45 * c) * (0.5 + 0.5 * grow);
  ctx.fillStyle = rgba(tint, (0.2 + d * 0.7) * grow);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(a[0], a[1], s / 2, s / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}

// 逐字入场：每个字按自己的延迟上移、淡入；整行的发光交给图层上的 GPU glow。
function animatedText(ctx, text, y, size, weight, spacing, color, t, start, step, rise) {
  ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif`; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.fillStyle = color;
  const chars = [...text], widths = chars.map(ch => ctx.measureText(ch).width);
  const total = widths.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) + spacing * Math.max(0, chars.length - 1);
  let cursor = 960 - total / 2;
  chars.forEach((ch, i) => {
    const local = progress(t, start + i * step, 0.5);
    if (local > 0) { ctx.globalAlpha = local; ctx.fillText(ch, cursor, y + rise * (1 - expoOut(progress(t, start + i * step, 0.85)))) }
    cursor += widths[i] + spacing;
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

export default {
  name: '复杂到简单_片头', kind: 'generator', mode: 'dynamic', width: 1920, height: 1080, durationSeconds: 6,
  params: [
    { key: 'title', type: 'text', title: '主标题', default: '把复杂的事做简单' },
    { key: 'subtitle', type: 'text', title: '副标题', default: '痕迹 AI' },
    { key: 'count', type: 'number', title: '节点数（复杂度）', min: 40, max: 300, step: 1, default: 180 },
    { key: 'collapseAt', type: 'number', title: '收束起点（秒）', min: 0.4, max: 2.4, step: 0.05, default: 1.4 },
    { key: 'ink', type: 'color', title: '文字色', default: '#f0f6fa' },
    { key: 'accent', type: 'color', title: '强调色', default: '#6bccff' },
  ],
  layers(params, w, h, assets, info) {
    const accent = params.accent, ink = params.ink;
    const collapse = t => cubicInOut(clamp((t - params.collapseAt) / 1.55, 0, 1));
    const lineP = t => expoOut(progress(t, 2.9, 0.95));
    return [
      { id: 'sky', cacheKey: 'sky', draw(ctx) {
        const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
        sky.addColorStop(0, 'rgb(11, 15, 22)'); sky.addColorStop(0.58, 'rgb(6, 8, 13)'); sky.addColorStop(1, 'rgb(3, 4, 7)');
        ctx.fillStyle = sky; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      } },
      // 环境光的亮度按 1/100 档取整：只在肉眼可见的变化时重画、重新上传整幅渐变。
      { id: 'ambient', cacheKey: Math.round((0.03 + 0.07 * lineP(info.time) + 0.01 * Math.sin(info.time * 1.6)) * 100), draw(ctx, t) {
        const ambient = ctx.createRadialGradient(w / 2, 528, 0, w / 2, 528, 1020), p = lineP(t);
        ambient.addColorStop(0, rgba(accent, Math.round((0.03 + 0.07 * p + 0.01 * Math.sin(t * 1.6)) * 100) / 100));
        ambient.addColorStop(0.5, rgba(accent, 0.011 + 0.026 * p)); ambient.addColorStop(1, rgba(accent, 0));
        ctx.fillStyle = ambient; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      } },
      { id: 'tangle', draw(ctx, t) {
        const c = collapse(t), gone = smoothstep(0.68, 1, c);
        if (gone >= 1) return;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - gone; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        for (let i = 0; i < params.count; i++) strand(ctx, i, i + 1, t, c, w, accent);
        for (let i = 0; i < 140; i++) strand(ctx, i * 2, i * 2 + 13, t, c, w, accent);
        for (let i = 0; i < params.count; i++) dot(ctx, i, t, c, w, accent);
      } },
      { id: 'ghost', draw(ctx, t) {
        ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(accent, 0.24 * collapse(t)); ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(58, 540); ctx.lineTo(w - 58, 540); ctx.stroke();
      } },
      { id: 'rule', bounds: [w / 2 - 460, 520, w / 2 + 460, 560], cacheKey: 'rule', motionBlur: false, effects: () => [glow({ radius: 18, strength: 60 })],
        pose: t => lineP(t) <= 0 ? null : { x: w / 2 * (1 - lineP(t)), scaleX: lineP(t), opacity: 0.92 },
        draw(ctx) { ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.strokeStyle = ink; ctx.lineWidth = 2.4; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w / 2 - 442, 540); ctx.lineTo(w / 2 + 442, 540); ctx.stroke() } },
      { id: 'sweep', bounds: [w / 2 - 520, 520, w / 2 - 380, 560], cacheKey: 'sweep', motionBlur: false, effects: () => [glow({ radius: 14, strength: 50 })],
        pose: t => { const s = progress(t, 4.5, 1.05); return s <= 0 || s >= 1 ? null : { x: 884 * s, opacity: 0.5 * Math.sin(Math.PI * s) * lineP(t) } },
        draw(ctx) { ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.strokeStyle = 'white'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w / 2 - 498, 540); ctx.lineTo(w / 2 - 386, 540); ctx.stroke() } },
      { id: 'title', bounds: [180, 330, 1740, 580], effects: () => [glow({ radius: 12, strength: 30 })], draw(ctx, t) { animatedText(ctx, params.title, 452, 104, 700, lerp(16, 6, expoOut(progress(t, 3, 1.15))), ink, t, 3, 0.055, 88) } },
      { id: 'subtitle', bounds: [560, 500, 1360, 780], draw(ctx, t) { animatedText(ctx, params.subtitle, 632, 38, 400, lerp(30, 12, expoOut(progress(t, 4.35, 1.05))), 'rgba(163, 189, 209, 0.95)', t, 4.35, 0.07, -96) } },
    ];
  },
};
